title: Kyoot Bikes Flat Pack Pizza Rack
content:
Kyoot Bikes‘ mini velos just got a power-up! A Pizza Rack power-up. Introducing the Kyoot Bikes Flat Pack Pizza Rack ($120), a simple, versatile cargo platform designed specifically for the Chromoly Rolly Polly and Itty Bitty mini velos. The rack clamps directly to the bike’s head tube and with a 25 lb payload, this system will keep your steering stable.

When you don’t need it, the rack can be removed with a 4 mm Allen key, disassembled, and packed completely flat for travel or storage. There is standard M5 hardware throughout, so if you ever lose a bolt, you won’t be hunting down some weird proprietary replacement.

Even though the rack is proprietary, there is a slight chance it might fit other 1 1/8 steerer bikes but caveat emptor it is specifically designed for Kyoot’s steel Rolly Polly and Itty Bitty models.

Check out this 2026 December delivery pre-order at Kyoot Bikes.
